zh.text: 剑桥大学是位于英国剑桥市的一所公立研究型大学。其历史可追溯至1209年，由一群离开牛津的学者建立。1231年，该校获得亨利三世颁发的皇家特许状。大学实行学院联邦制，由31所成员学院及超过150个学系组成。本科生教学以学院内的每周小组辅导为核心，辅以讲座和实验。

en.text: The University of Cambridge is a public research university located in Cambridge, England. Its origins date back to 1209, when scholars moved from Oxford to Cambridge following a dispute. In 1231, King Henry III granted the university a royal charter. It operates as a collegiate federation comprising 31 constituent colleges and over 150 academic departments. Undergraduate education is centered on weekly small-group supervisions within the colleges, supported by lectures and laboratory work.
